I am glad to see real repercussions for the heinous sexual improprieties that both Tony Gonzales and Eric Swalwell have exhibited in Congress. I do however hate that Tony’s actions have left a vacancy for the representation of District 23. 

In the meantime, I promise to do everything in my power to advocate for the constituents of this district at a federal level in the interim until I’m able

Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (@RepLuna)

If Congressman Swalwell has not resigned with the Clerk of the House by 2 PM today, I will continue my resolution regarding his expulsion. His statement about his “plan to resign his seat” is not binding and is wormy. The same goes for Tony.



— https://nitter.net/RepLuna/status/2044047389699219487#m

No, I’m not happy this happened. 

Nothing about this story brings my joy. 

I hate that women were victimized by him. 

I’m horrified his wife and children are having to go through this.

I’ll be praying that these women find the comfort and healing only Jesus can bring. And I hope Eric finds that same Healer too.


Rep. Eric Swalwell (@RepSwalwell)
